display.purpose: The cover title only, in light foil gold.

headline.purpose: Entry page headings in navy; first baseline snapped to the 32px ruling. 28px on 32px lines below 900px. Declared 600 renders the Regular file.

body.purpose: Running entry text on the 32px ruling, max 62ch.

typed.purpose: Record data: dealer values (16px), plate captions (15px/1.4), colophon (14px).

label.purpose: Uppercase form labels in the dealer list (0.14em) and stamp boxes (500, 0.12em). Declared 600 renders the Medium file.

label-small.purpose: Homepage v2: Archivo Narrow 600, 11px, uppercase, 0.14 to 0.16em. Type-plate cell labels, work-order meta and column heads, the last-day label, the blueprint title block, the postcard head and car line.

shadows.name: plate-on-stock

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: All CSS transitions.

motion.name: button-straighten
motion.purpose: Stamp-box buttons rotate to 0deg and lift 1px on hover, drop 1px on press.

motion.name: stamp-press
motion.purpose: Entry stamp settles from scale 1.35, -14deg, blur 3px to scale 1, -6deg as the car passes.

motion.name: seal-press
motion.purpose: Dealer seal settles from scale 1.4, -30deg to -16deg at the end of the drive.

motion.name: stage-reveal
motion.purpose: The 3D canvas fades in once models are ready.

motion.name: drive-follow
motion.purpose: Scroll-driven drive; the vehicle settles at 58% of viewport height.

motion.name: car-to-truck
motion.purpose: Vehicle change; never a shape morph.

motion.name: garage-shade
motion.value: darken past door threshold toward #75624e (sampled from the archive photo), then dissolve
motion.purpose: The truck disappears into the 1954 garage.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: no transitions; fixed poses; all stamps applied
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion and no-WebGL end state.

motion.name: digit-roll
motion.purpose: Margin rail year readout: each digit strip rolls to the year of the leaf being read.

motion.name: leaf-tone
motion.purpose: Readout (and narrow-screen top bar) background follows the tone of the leaf under it.

motion.name: foil-seal-press
motion.purpose: Foil seal on the front cover settles from scale 1.4, -30deg to -14deg when the cover arrives.

motion.name: seam-sweep
motion.value: 2200ms, ease-out cubic (1 - (1 - t)^3), 300ms delay; from 100% to 52%
motion.purpose: Miras cover then/now plate: the seam sweeps once from all-archive to its rest mark when the photo has loaded and half the plate is in view. Any touch stops it. Reduced motion: rests at 52%.

motion.name: plate-develop
motion.purpose: Miras archive plates develop from pale soft paper to the full print at 35% in view. Script-gated; reduced motion shows them developed.

motion.name: board-open
motion.purpose: Miras viewing board (native dialog) opening. None under reduced motion.

motion.name: film-hold
motion.purpose: Miras facade film: stops when off-screen and on request; no autoplay under reduced motion.

motion.name: tab-turn
motion.purpose: Homepage v2 service board: a new leaf slides in 18px from the fore-edge.

motion.name: paraf-write
motion.purpose: Homepage v2 work order: the paraf writes itself when the car draws level, then the tick presses in.

motion.name: tick-press
motion.purpose: Tick boxes: the stamp-violet tick presses in from scale 1.4, -8deg.

motion.name: deck-move
motion.purpose: Homepage v2 postcards move between deck slots.

motion.name: floor-wipe
motion.purpose: Homepage v2 floor page: the floor drawing wipes in from the left on a tab change.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Cover stacks above the leaf; entries become one column.

narrative.overview:
The site is a car's service booklet, printed and handled. A navy cover with a gold-foil frame opens onto pale blue-grey card stock ruled every 32px. Archive and current photos are tipped in as white-bordered plates. Violet-blue rubber stamps mark each page. A faint printed road runs down the stock, and the 3D cars drive it. Every surface is a physical booklet material: cover board, ruled stock, photo plate, stamp ink, foil. Nothing is a screen panel.

Density is that of a filled-in booklet: generous ruled pages, one entry per page, text on one side and a plate on the other, sides alternating with the road. The type is a working document's mix: a Clarendon-style serif for titles and running text, a typewriter face for typed-in record data, and a condensed grotesk for printed form labels. Colour is few and flat: navy, gold, stock, ink, and stamp violet.

The world refuses the dark showroom hero and the row of rounded service cards. Depth comes from paper on paper (a plate lying on stock) and from the 3D stage, never from glass, glow, or gradient.
keyCharacteristics: Navy cover board framed by a double gold-foil rule.
Pale ruled card stock; vertical rhythm locked to the 32px ruling.
Photos as tipped-in plates: white border, slight rotation, soft paper shadow.
Rubber stamps in violet-blue ink with a noise-roughened edge, slightly rotated, multiplied onto the paper.
Double-ruled stamp-box buttons with a small tilt; square corners everywhere.
A faint navy-ink road that the 3D vehicles follow on scroll.

rules.name: The Brand Record Rule
rules.body: Navy, gold, silver, near-black, and white come from LOGO_2026.pdf and are not retuned. Stock, rules, stamp violet, and the lighter gold are design decisions and may be adjusted; brand values may not.

rules.name: The Foil Is Not Ink Rule
rules.body: Foil gold draws lines on navy. Text on navy uses light foil gold or stock.

rules.name: The Typed Data Rule
rules.body: Addresses, phone numbers, hours, captions, and the colophon are typed record data and use Courier Prime. Running prose stays in Besley.

rules.name: The Form Label Rule
rules.body: Archivo Narrow appears only as short uppercase labels, button text, and stamp text, never as running copy.

rules.name: The Paper On Paper Rule
rules.body: The only shadow is a plate resting on stock. Buttons, stamps, and the dealer block stay flat.

rules.name: The Aged Stock Rule
rules.body: On a page that turns back through time, each leaf is one flat stock tone, and older leaves are warmer: card stock, then faded stock, yellowed stock, archive cream. The tone changes only at a leaf's cut edge, never as a gradient inside a leaf. Aged tones are for dated leaves only; they are not a general surface palette.

rules.name: The Cut Edge Rule
rules.body: The page-block edge is drawn, not cast: flat strips and lines only, no shadow and no gradient. It is a printed edge, so it does not break the Paper On Paper Rule.

rules.name: The Foil Seal Rule
rules.body: On navy the seal is foil, not ink: light foil gold, crisp, unblended. Stamp violet with the ink filter and multiply stays on stock.

rules.name: The Ceremonial Edition Rule
rules.body: The 72px chapter headings and the 96px title are the heritage page's edition of the booklet, led by navy board. Other pages keep the base ramp (headline at 40px, 600).

rules.name: The Handle Is A Seal Rule
rules.body: The then/now handle is a small foil seal on navy: round, flat, double-ringed in light foil gold. It is the second circle in the system, after the round seal.

rules.name: The Booklet Pages Edition Rule
rules.body: The 60px to 104px sizes belong to navy boards, the back cover, and printed figures on anasayfa-v2.html. A section heading set on stock keeps the base headline (40px, 600) unless it opens the heritage part of the page.

rules.name: The Index Tab Rule
rules.body: Choices inside a section are square index tabs on the edge of the board or page they open.

dos: **Do** keep every vertical measure on the stock a multiple of the 32px ruling, and snap any off-grid heading back onto it.
**Do** tip photos in as plates: 10px white border, the plate shadow, a small lane-matched rotation.
**Do** apply stamps in stamp violet with the ink filter and multiply blending, slightly rotated.
**Do** use double-ruled, square stamp boxes for calls to action, with one primary per set.
**Do** keep record data (address, phone, hours, captions) in Courier Prime and form labels in uppercase Archivo Narrow.
**Do** use foil gold only as lines on navy, and light foil gold for text and fills on navy.
**Do** give every motion a reduced-motion end state where stamps are already applied and vehicles stand still.
Do give each leaf of a reverse-turned page one flat aged-stock tone, warmer as it gets older.
Do show an undated year as four separate blank underlines and caption undated archive plates "Arşivden, tarihsiz: …".
Do press the seal in light foil gold, without the ink filter or multiply, when it sits on navy.
**Do** give every then/now plate a native range input with `aria-valuetext`, and let reduced motion rest the seam at its mark.
**Do** give every moving film a stop control and pause it off-screen.
Do keep boards, plates, and text clear of the road lane; on narrow screens give the lane side 48px to 80px of padding.
Do set large figures (plate values, scores, dates) in Courier Prime Bold with tabular numerals.
Do offer choices inside a section as square index tabs on the edge of the board or page, as ARIA tabs with arrow keys, Home and End.
donts: **Don't** round corners. The booklet is cut square.
**Don't** add shadows to buttons, stamps, or the dealer block; the only shadow is a plate resting on stock.
**Don't** use gradients, glass, glow, or a dark showroom backdrop behind the cover or the stage.
**Don't** retune the brand navy, gold, silver, near-black, or white from LOGO_2026.pdf.
**Don't** set foil gold text on navy; it fails contrast.
**Don't** set running copy in Archivo Narrow or Courier Prime.
**Don't** let the browser synthesize bold for Besley or Archivo Narrow.
**Don't** morph vehicle shapes into each other; vehicle changes are noise dissolves.
Don't draw the page-block edge with a shadow or a gradient; it is flat strips and cut lines.
